def factor_volatility_instability(df):
    """Volatility instability: rolling standard deviation of short-horizon realized volatility, capturing regime breakdown precursors."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    ret = df_copy["close"].pct_change()
    vol_short = ret.rolling(10, min_periods=5).std()
    vol_change = vol_short.rolling(20, min_periods=10).std()
    df_copy["factor_volatility_instability"] = vol_change
    return df_copy["factor_volatility_instability"]
description: Volatility of volatility (vol-of-vol) surges when market conditions transition from calm to turbulent, often preceding crashes or regime breakdowns. This factor computes the standard deviation of short-horizon realized volatility over a longer window, isolating instability in risk itself. Unlike simple volatility, it picks up on the acceleration or deceleration of risk, a hallmark of fragility. The mechanism uses only past daily close returns and explores an uncovered raw pathway in this domain.
